csr.description: Our Business Motivation is to conduct transparent business operations based on market mechanism within the legal, ethical & social framework with aims to attain the mission reflected by our vision. We scale-up CSR activities to consider the interests of our external & internal stakeholders like customers, employees, vendors, shareholders, society, government etc. and ecological & ethical considerations in all aspects of operations.
initiatives: PDC Engineers & Associates is sponsoring a youth team to create social consciousness for clean water & fresh air.
We are campaigning in different clusters to encourage against water pollution & air pollution.
